<b>Cogwork Crawlers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are small [[Cogwork Bugs|automatons]] with long retractable pins on their backs.<ref>Cogwork Crawler [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Automaton built in the shape of a scuttling bug. Its back contains retractable pins, intended to cut song cylinders free of any obstruction."</i></ref> 

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Cogwork Crawlers crawl up and down unpredictably along walls, pausing frequently. Once [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] approaches or attacks them, they stop moving and extend long pins from their backs for around 1.5 seconds. Even whilst retracted, the pins shield them from horizontal Needle attacks and most [[Tools]].

[[Needle#Needle-bouncing|Needle-bouncing]] or up-slashes are all that is required to kill them, as they cannot defend the space above or below themselves.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Cogwork Crawlers have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

==Trivia==
* "Song cylinders" (as opposed to [[Psalm Cylinder]]s) likely refer to the rotating cylindrical structures found in the [[Cogwork Core]].<ref>Modded [[:File:Screenshot SS Cogwork Core 20.png|screenshot]] of a cylinder in the Cogwork Core.</ref>
* When singing, Cogwork Crawlers produce the same chirping sounds as [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s and [[Maestro]]'s [[Cogfly|Cogflies]].
